Frequently asked questions

Quick answers

Where are my gameplay statistics stored?

They are stored locally on your device using Apple’s UserDefaults storage. Arcade MD has no account or developer-hosted server, and the current version does not sync statistics between devices.

Does Arcade MD need an internet connection?

No. The current version is designed to work offline and its gameplay content is included in the app.

Does Arcade MD use analytics or advertising?

No. The current version does not include analytics, advertising, tracking, or third-party SDKs.

Does the app request access to photos or location?

No. The current version does not request access to photos, the camera, location, the microphone, contacts, or health data.

How do I delete my statistics?

The current version does not include an in-app reset control. Removing Arcade MD and its stored data through iOS removes the locally stored statistics.

Is Arcade MD medical advice?

No. Arcade MD is an educational game and is not medical advice or a clinical decision-support tool. It should not be used to diagnose, treat, or make decisions about medical care.
